digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow / coverage collection strategy
propositions: Coverage instrumentation is measured at 34s wall-clock overhead per uninstrumented cell (median local_delta on A-B-B-A-A-B experiment)
Three Ubuntu cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) independently collect and enforce identical coverage floor, producing duplicate tracing without distinct verdicts
Production code contains no sys.version_info or sys.version branches, so behavioral compatibility is covered by retaining all cells uninstrumented except the primary
Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be the sole coverage-collecting cell while 3.11, 3.12, and macOS 3.13 retain both pytest tiers uninstrumented
Django, NumPy, and SciPy consensus shows selective primary-cell or dedicated-job coverage collection is established OSS practice (3/3 projects)
